messages:
Marco: Quick sync  we need a publish plan that covers Node (CJS + ESM), Edge (Workers/Deno/Bun), and bundlers. Keep the package ergonomic for sample apps.
Yuki: Agreed. Biggest friction so far: TS consumers on older toolchains (TS 4.3/4.4) can't always find types if we rely only on exports.types.
Leila: I propose top-level "types" + exports mapping. Minimal exports to prevent deep imports. Also ensure we don't accidentally ship Node-only code in the ESM edge build.
Marco: Example exports snippet I tested (feel free to nit): 
Marco: {"import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"} as the "." export.
Omar: Note: some bundlers (older webpack) will still prefer main/module fields. Keep main/module for backward compat.
DevBot: CI: nightly artifacts at https://ci.internal/redsdk/1801 (esm/cjs/types builds).
Yuki: Edge runtime notes: Bun currently supports require-ish interop but also prefers ESM. Deno expects ESM with proper exports and sometimes import assertions. Cloudflare Workers need pure ESM and no synchronous crypto.
Leila: Implementation detail: avoid runtime imports like require('fs') at top-level. Lazy-load Node-only helpers via dynamic import in Node path. That way ESM build for edge remains free of fs references.
Marco: Auth and network: prefer global fetch when available; allow a `fetchImplementation` override option. For Node if undici is available we'll use it, otherwise fallback to node's fetch.
Omar: Retry default discussion: browsers/edge should be conservative. Suggest default retries = 1 for edge, 2 for Node. Expose global config and per-call override. Document the backoff algorithm.
Yuki: Typings: bundle a single dist/types/index.d.ts. Keep the types surface minimal and use overloads for runtime options (e.g., node-specific agent options) instead of separate type files. Add a tiny README section about TS resolver issues and propose `typesVersions` mapping for older TS.
Leila: Tests: add CI smoke tests: Node LTS CJS, Node ESM, webpack bundle (simulate electron), rollup/esbuild bundling, Cloudflare Wrangler, Deno (import only), Bun local run. Fail CI if ESM artifact contains `require(` or `process.env` or `fs.` strings.
Marco: Examples: add two example apps - examples/next-edge-sample and examples/workers-sample. They should import the package normally and use `fetch`-based auth flow.
Omar: Small gotcha: Authorization header + browser credentials. SDK sets Authorization: Bearer <key> but browser callers must set credentials policy explicitly. Add a short note: "By default we omit cookies; set fetch credentials if you need them."
Yuki: Action items:
- @Leila: update build script to emit dist/{cjs,esm,types} and add top-level "types" entry
- @Marco: add feature-detect wrapper for fetch/crypto and provide fetchImplementation hook
- @Omar: draft CI matrix and add string checks to fail on Node-only APIs leaking into ESM
- @Yuki: docs blurb on TS <4.5 resolver quirks + typesVersions snippet

Leila: Will prototype this week. If anyone hits a weird TS consumer, ping and we'll add a psuedo-package with alternate types as a fallback. :thumbsup:
